d:
Jharkhand men kangres vidhayak par nabalig dvara lagae gae aaropon ke bad pradesh ki rajniti garma gaee hai. is mamle ko lekar satta paksh aur vipaksh ke netaon ke bich bayanbaji tej ho gaee hai. aaropon par shuru huee siyasat ke bich neta ek-dusre par nishana sadhte najar aae. aakhir kya hai pura mamla aur kisne kya kaha? dekhie is riport men.
